name: labs/prathameshnium__pica-python-instrument-control-and-automation
title: Cryo-con 34 temperature controller (PICA Cryocon34Backend)
intro: Cryo-con 34 temperature controller (PICA Cryocon34Backend), adapted from prathameshnium/pica-python-instrument-control-and-automation. It reads `temperature`, `control_engaged`, `heater_readback`, `ramp_rate` and 11 more; sets `setpoint`, `loop_type`, `loop_source`, `max_power` and 4 more; runs `control_engage` and `control_stop`. `control_engage`: engage every enabled control loop at the configured setpoint (native CONTROL). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
